description: THE FRONT DOOR FOR BUYING. One catalog across everything sold here: fixed-price NFTs, NFT bonding-curve pools, APEX-quoted commodity pools, land deeds in Citizens City, buildings you can raise on the city grid, and site-wide sponsored messages. Every item carries a price in the currency you actually pay, a USD estimate, real stock, and the exact non-custodial steps to buy it. Filter with q, type, market, availability, currency and max_price. Start here instead of querying six separate systems.
